question: What liberating and adversarial powers are attributed to the deity in this salutation?
premises: The deity is addressed as liberator from good bonds.
The deity is addressed as enemy of sacrifice.
inference: The deity liberates from bonds and opposes sacrifice.
uncertainties: The compound sayajñāraye may imply opposition to sacrificial rites or to enemies of sacrifice.
plain_english: Obeisance to the liberator from strong bonds, obeisance to the enemy of sacrifice.
